name: Garlic Herb Pork Tenderloin Medallions
steps: Slice the pork into medallions and rub with garlic, herbs and mustard.
Sear in oil 3 minutes a side.
Roast the asparagus alongside for 10 minutes.

name: Pork Chops with Mushroom Pan Sauce
steps: Sear the seasoned chops in oil; set aside.
Brown the mushrooms and garlic in butter, add broth and thyme and reduce.
Return the chops and simmer 6 minutes.

name: Grilled Sirloin with Chimichurri and Roasted Zucchini
steps: Grill the steak to taste and rest.
Chop the parsley with garlic, vinegar, oil and oregano.
Roast the zucchini slices and serve everything together.

name: Italian Beef Stew with Peppers and Tomatoes
steps: Brown the cubed beef in oil.
Add the onion, garlic, peppers, tomatoes, broth and seasoning.
Simmer covered 100 minutes until tender.

name: Steak Tips with Garlic Butter Mushrooms
steps: Sear the cubed steak in a hot pan, 2 minutes a side, and set aside.
Brown the mushrooms in butter with garlic.
Return the steak and finish with parsley.

name: Beef and Vegetable Kebabs
steps: Marinate the beef cubes in oil, spices and lemon.
Thread onto skewers with the vegetables.
Grill 10 to 12 minutes, turning.

name: Lamb Burgers with Feta and Cucumber Yogurt
steps: Mix the lamb with feta, garlic, cumin and half the mint and shape four patties.
Grill 5 minutes a side.
Stir the yogurt with grated cucumber and the rest of the mint.
Serve in lettuce with the sauce.

name: Slow Cooker Lamb Shoulder with Rosemary and Garlic
steps: Stud the lamb with garlic and rosemary.
Set on the onion and carrots in the slow cooker with broth and lemon.
Cook on low 7 hours.

name: Greek Lamb Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
steps: Mix the lamb, egg, oat bran, garlic and oregano and shape meatballs.
Brown, then simmer in the marinara 15 minutes.
Top with feta and parsley.

name: Ground Beef and Cabbage Skillet
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic.
Add the cabbage, paste, broth and paprika.
Cook covered 12 minutes.

name: Taco-Stuffed Zucchini Boats
steps: Halve and scoop out the zucchini.
Brown the beef with the seasoning and sauce.
Fill the boats, top with cheddar and bake at 400°F for 25 minutes.

name: Beef Stir-Fry with Snap Peas and Peppers
steps: Toss the sliced steak in arrowroot and sear in oil.
Stir-fry the vegetables with garlic and ginger.
Combine with soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Meatball Marinara Bake with Zucchini Noodles
steps: Mix the meats, egg, parmesan and seasoning and shape meatballs.
Bake in the marinara at 400°F for 20 minutes.
Top with mozzarella and serve over the zucchini noodles.

name: Pork Carnitas Bowls with Cabbage and Lime
steps: Rub the pork with the spices and slow cook with orange juice and garlic for 7 hours.
Shred and crisp under the broiler.
Serve over cabbage with lime, avocado and cilantro.

name: Pozole Rojo with Pork
steps: Simmer the pork with the onion, garlic, chili powder, oregano and broth for 70 minutes.
Add the beans and cook 15 minutes.
Serve with cabbage, radish and lime.

name: Barbacoa-Style Beef Tacos
steps: Slow cook the beef with chipotle, lime, cumin, garlic and onion for 7 hours.
Shred and serve in warm tortillas with cilantro.

name: Grilled Pork Souvlaki with Tzatziki
steps: Marinate the pork cubes in lemon, garlic, oregano and oil.
Skewer and grill 10 to 12 minutes.
Mix the yogurt with grated cucumber, dill and garlic.
Serve in warm pitas.

name: Italian Sausage with Peppers and Onions over Polenta-Style Grits
steps: Brown the sausage in oil.
Add the peppers, onion and marinara and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over grits stirred with parmesan.

name: Pork Chops with Sauteed Apples and Onions
steps: Sear the chops in oil; set aside.
Cook the apple and onion in butter with thyme.
Add the vinegar, return the chops and simmer 6 minutes.

name: Corned Beef-Style Brisket with Cabbage and Carrots
steps: Simmer the beef in the broth with vinegar, onion, bay and pepper for 2 hours.
Add the potatoes and carrots for 30 minutes, then the cabbage for the last 20.

name: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy
steps: Mix the beef, egg, oat bran and mustard and form oval patties; brown.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the pan, add broth thickened with arrowroot.
Return the patties and simmer 15 minutes.

name: Moroccan-Spiced Lamb with Chickpeas
steps: Brown the cubed lamb with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, tomatoes, chickpeas and broth and simmer 80 minutes.
Finish with cilantro.

name: Beef and Bean Burrito Bowls
steps: Brown the beef with the seasoning.
Build bowls from rice, beans, beef and lettuce.
Top with tomato, avocado, cheddar and salsa.

name: Hawaiian Pork Chops with Pineapple Salsa
steps: Rub the chops with paprika and oil and grill 6 minutes a side.
Mix the pineapple, onion, cilantro, lime and jalapeno.
Serve the salsa over the chops.

name: Spicy Pork Lettuce Wraps
steps: Brown the pork with garlic and ginger.
Add the water chestnuts, soy sauce and sriracha.
Spoon into lettuce cups with green onion and sesame oil.

name: Venison Chili
steps: Brown the venison with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer 50 minutes.

name: Bison Meatloaf with Mushrooms
steps: Sauté the chopped mushrooms and onion.
Mix with the bison, egg, oat bran and salt and press into a loaf pan.
Spread with paste and bake at 375°F for 50 minutes.

name: Pan-Seared Halibut with Lemon Caper Sauce
steps: Sear the halibut in half the butter, 4 minutes a side.
Sauté the garlic and spinach.
Warm the lemon, capers and remaining butter and spoon over.

name: Blackened Mahi Mahi Tacos with Mango Slaw
steps: Coat the fish in the seasoning and sear in oil, 4 minutes a side.
Toss the cabbage with mango, lime and cilantro.
Flake the fish into warm tortillas with the slaw.

name: Baked Trout with Almonds and Green Beans
steps: Bake the trout at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Brown the almonds in butter and add the lemon.
Steam the beans and spoon the almond butter over everything.

name: Seared Sea Scallops with Cauliflower Puree
steps: Boil and blend the cauliflower with milk, garlic and half the butter.
Sear the dried scallops in oil, 2 minutes a side.
Serve over the puree with chives and the remaining butter.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp over Spaghetti Squash
steps: Roast and shred the squash.
Sauté the garlic in butter, cook the shrimp 3 minutes.
Add lemon and toss with the squash and parsley.

name: Cod Veracruz with Tomatoes and Olives
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and jalapeno in oil.
Add the tomatoes, olives and capers and simmer 10 minutes.
Nestle in the cod and cook 8 minutes; finish with cilantro.

name: Salmon Teriyaki Bowls with Broccoli
steps: Bake the salmon brushed with soy sauce, vinegar, ginger, garlic and sweetener at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Steam the broccoli.
Serve over rice with sesame seeds.

name: Tuna Poke Salad with Avocado and Cucumber
steps: Cube the tuna and marinate with soy sauce, sesame oil and lime.
Arrange over lettuce with cucumber and avocado.
Top with green onion and sesame seeds.

name: Grilled Swordfish with Tomato Olive Relish
steps: Grill the swordfish 5 to 6 minutes a side.
Mix the tomatoes, olives, capers, basil, oil and vinegar.
Spoon over the fish.

name: Crab-Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Remove the mushroom stems.
Mix the crab, cream cheese, parmesan, Old Bay, green onion and lemon.
Fill the caps and bake at 400°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp and Broccoli Skillet
steps: Sauté the garlic in butter, cook the shrimp 3 minutes and set aside.
Steam-sauté the broccoli in the pan.
Return the shrimp and finish with lemon.

name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Bok Choy
steps: Whisk the miso, vinegar, ginger and sweetener and brush on the cod.
Bake at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Sauté the bok choy in sesame oil.

name: Sardine and Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon and spread.
Top with sardines, pepper flakes and parsley.

name: Mackerel with Roasted Fennel and Orange
steps: Roast the sliced fennel with oil at 425°F for 12 minutes.
Add the mackerel and orange slices and roast 10 minutes.

name: Snapper Veracruz-Style with Roasted Peppers
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in oil, add the tomato and peppers.
Add the olives and snapper and cook covered 12 minutes.
Finish with lime.

name: Seared Tuna Steak with Avocado Mash
steps: Sear the tuna 90 seconds a side and slice.
Mash the avocado with lime.
Serve with cucumber, soy sauce and sesame seeds.

name: Shrimp and Avocado Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Poach and chop the shrimp.
Mix with avocado, lime, onion and cilantro.
Fill the hollowed tomatoes.

name: Clam Linguine with White Wine and Garlic
steps: Cook the pasta.
Sauté the garlic in oil, add the clams and wine and cover until they open.
Toss with the pasta and parsley.

name: Lobster Tail with Lemon Butter and Asparagus
steps: Split and broil the lobster tails 8 minutes.
Melt the butter with garlic and lemon.
Roast the asparagus and serve with the lobster and butter.

name: Fish Chowder with Corn and Potatoes
steps: Crisp the bacon, soften the onion and celery.
Add the broth, potatoes, corn and thyme and simmer 12 minutes.
Add the milk and cod and cook 8 minutes.

name: Cioppino-Style Seafood Stew
steps: Soften the onion, fennel and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes, wine and seasoning and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the cod, then shrimp and mussels, and cook until the shells open.

name: Zucchini Lasagna with Turkey Ricotta Filling
steps: Slice the zucchini lengthwise and salt to draw out water.
Brown the turkey and stir in the marinara; mix the ricotta with egg and parmesan.
Layer zucchini, ricotta, sauce and mozzarella and bake at 375°F for 40 minutes.

name: Classic Meat Lasagna
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and stir in the marinara and seasoning.
Mix the ricotta with egg and parmesan.
Layer cooked noodles, ricotta, sauce and mozzarella and bake at 375°F for 45 minutes.

name: Chicken Parmesan Meatball Skillet
steps: Mix the chicken, egg, parmesan, oat bran and garlic and shape meatballs.
Brown them and simmer in the marinara 12 minutes.
Top with mozzarella to melt and finish with basil.

name: Sausage and Broccoli Rabe Orecchiette Style Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta.
Brown the sausage with garlic and pepper flakes, add the broccolini.
Toss with the pasta, oil and parmesan.

name: Shrimp Fra Diavolo over Spaghetti
steps: Cook the spaghetti.
Simmer the garlic, pepper flakes, wine and tomatoes 10 minutes.
Add the shrimp for 4 minutes and toss with the pasta and basil.

name: Turkey Sausage Minestrone
steps: Brown the sausage.
Add the vegetables, tomatoes, beans, broth and seasoning and simmer 25 minutes.
Add the kale for the last 5.

name: Baked Gnocchi-Style Cauliflower with Marinara and Mozzarella
steps: Roast the florets in oil at 425°F for 15 minutes.
Toss with the marinara and garlic in a dish.
Top with cheeses and bake 12 minutes; finish with basil.

name: Italian Chopped Chicken Salad
steps: Chop the romaine and combine with chicken, chickpeas, tomatoes, mozzarella and onion.
Dress with vinegar, oil and seasoning.

name: Pizza-Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Halve the peppers and parboil 4 minutes.
Brown the sausage with the mushrooms and stir in the marinara.
Fill the peppers, top with mozzarella and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Pesto Chicken with Roasted Tomatoes and Zucchini
steps: Spread the chicken with pesto.
Roast with the tomatoes and zucchini in oil at 400°F for 22 minutes.
Top with mozzarella for the last 3.

name: Chicken Burrito Smothered with Enchilada Sauce
steps: Cook and shred the chicken; mix with beans, rice and onion.
Roll in tortillas and set seam-down in a dish.
Cover with sauce and cheddar and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Beef Chimichangas, Baked
steps: Brown the beef with the seasoning and mix with the beans.
Fill the tortillas with beef and cheddar, fold and brush with oil.
Bake at 425°F for 15 to 18 minutes and serve with salsa.

name: Chicken Tamale Pie Muffins
steps: Stir the egg into the cooked grits and press into muffin cups.
Fill with shredded chicken, beans, corn and sauce and top with cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 22 to 25 minutes.

name: Huevos Divorciados
steps: Crisp the tortillas and top with beans.
Fry the eggs and set one on each side.
Spoon red salsa over one and green over the other; finish with cotija and avocado.

name: Mexican Street Corn Salad in a Cup
steps: Char the corn in a hot pan.
Mix with yogurt, lime and chili powder.
Fold in the cotija, onion and cilantro.

name: Black Bean and Corn Quesadillas
steps: Fill half of each tortilla with beans, corn and cheese and fold.
Crisp in a pan with oil, 2 minutes a side.
Serve with salsa.

name: Shredded Chicken Tostadas
steps: Crisp the tortillas in the oven.
Spread with beans, top with poached shredded chicken and lettuce.
Finish with tomato, avocado, cotija and lime.

name: Chicken Mole-Style Skillet
steps: Brown the chicken.
Simmer the onion, garlic, sauce, cocoa, chili, cinnamon, almonds and broth into a sauce.
Return the chicken and cook 20 minutes.

name: Fish Tacos Baja with Cabbage Crema
steps: Season and pan-sear the tilapia in oil.
Toss the cabbage with yogurt, lime and cilantro.
Fill warm tortillas with fish, slaw and avocado.

name: Carne Guisada, Slow-Simmered Beef
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, tomatoes, pepper, broth and potatoes.
Simmer covered 100 minutes.

name: Menudo-Style Beef Soup
steps: Simmer the beef with the onion, garlic, chili and oregano in the broth for 2 hours.
Add the beans and cook 20 minutes.
Serve with lime and cilantro.

name: Sopa de Lima with Chicken
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion, garlic, tomato and jalapeno in the broth 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken and add the lime.
Serve with crisp tortilla strips and cilantro.

name: Refried Bean and Cheese Burrito
steps: Warm the beans.
Fill the tortillas with beans, cheddar and salsa and roll.

name: Chicken Taquitos, Baked
steps: Mix the shredded chicken with cream cheese, salsa and cheddar.
Fill and roll warmed tortillas and brush with oil.
Bake at 425°F for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: Elote-Style Zucchini Boats
steps: Halve and scoop the zucchini.
Mix the corn with yogurt, lime, chili powder and half the cotija.
Fill the boats and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes; top with cotija and cilantro.

name: Mexican Rice with Tomato and Peas
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil with the cumin.
Add the sauce and broth, then fold in the rice and peas and heat through.

name: Chicken Salad Lettuce Sandwiches
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with celery, yogurt, mustard, lemon and almonds.
Pile into large lettuce leaves.

name: Open-Faced Turkey Melt with Apple and Cheddar
steps: Spread the toast with mustard.
Top with turkey, apple slices and cheddar.
Broil until melted.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich with Cucumber
steps: Hard-boil and chop the eggs.
Mix with yogurt, mustard and chives.
Spread on the bread with sliced cucumber.

name: Falafel Pita with Tahini and Tomato
steps: Mash the chickpeas with parsley and lemon into a quick falafel-style mix.
Stuff the pitas with it and tomato and cucumber.
Drizzle with tahini thinned with lemon.

name: Tuna Melt on Whole Grain
steps: Mix the tuna with yogurt and celery.
Pile on toast with tomato and cheddar and broil until melted.

name: Bunless Burger Bowls with Special Sauce
steps: Brown the beef.
Mix the yogurt, paste and mustard into a sauce.
Build bowls from lettuce, beef, tomato, pickle, onion and cheddar with the sauce.

name: Cuban-Style Pork and Swiss Wrap
steps: Roast and slice the pork.
Layer with ham, Swiss, pickle and mustard in the tortillas.
Press in a hot pan until crisp.

name: Greek Chicken Pita with Tzatziki
steps: Season the chicken with oregano and lemon and sear; slice.
Stir the yogurt with cucumber and garlic.
Fill the pitas.

name: Buffalo Chicken Wrap with Ranch
steps: Cook and shred the chicken and toss with the hot sauce.
Stir the yogurt with the ranch seasoning.
Fill the tortillas with chicken, lettuce, celery and ranch.

name: Garden Veggie Wrap with Hummus
steps: Spread the tortillas with hummus.
Layer the vegetables and feta and roll.

name: Cheddar Grits Muffins
steps: Stir the eggs, milk and melted butter into the cooked grits.
Fold in the almond flour, baking powder and cheddar.
Bake in a greased tin at 400°F for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Roasted Garlic Mashed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Roast the sweet potatoes and garlic until soft.
Mash with butter, milk, thyme and salt.

name: Herbed Roasted Baby Potatoes
steps: Toss the halved potatoes with oil, rosemary, garlic and salt.
Roast at 425°F for 30 minutes and finish with parsley.

name: Creamy Coleslaw with Apple and Dill
steps: Whisk the yogurt, mayo, vinegar and dill.
Toss with the slaw and diced apple.
Chill before serving.

name: Ginger Glazed Carrots
steps: Simmer the sliced carrots with butter, ginger and orange juice until glazed.
Finish with parsley.

name: Creamy Spinach Artichoke Baked Cups
steps: Wilt the spinach and chop with the artichokes.
Mix with the egg, ricotta, parmesan and garlic.
Divide into muffin cups and bake at 375°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Lemon Herb Quinoa Pilaf
steps: Toss the warm quinoa with lemon, oil, herbs and green onion.
Top with toasted almonds.

name: Skillet Corn with Jalapeno and Lime
steps: Char the corn in butter with the jalapeno.
Finish with lime, cilantro and cotija.

name: Turkey Chili Stuffed Baked Potatoes
steps: Bake the potatoes.
Brown the turkey with the onion, add the spices, tomatoes and beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Split the potatoes and fill with chili and cheddar.

name: Chicken Enchilada Casserole with Zucchini
steps: Layer the sliced zucchini, shredded chicken, beans, onion and sauce with torn tortillas in a dish.
Top with cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Broccoli Chicken Rice Bake
steps: Mix the cooked rice, chicken, broccoli, onion, milk and garlic powder in a dish.
Top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Ham and Potato Casserole
steps: Layer the sliced potatoes, ham, onion and peas in a dish.
Pour over the warm milk and butter and top with cheddar.
Bake covered at 375°F for 40 minutes.

name: Cheesy Cauliflower and Turkey Bake
steps: Roast the florets until tender.
Combine with the diced turkey, onion, garlic and milk in a dish.
Top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Hearty Chicken and Vegetable Stew
steps: Brown the chicken, then simmer with the onion, carrot, celery, thyme and broth 25 minutes.
Add the potatoes and peas and cook 12 minutes.
Thicken with an arrowroot slurry.

name: Split Pea Soup with Smoked Turkey
steps: Simmer everything 70 minutes until the peas break down.
Remove the bay leaf.

name: Sausage Kale and White Bean Soup
steps: Brown the sausage with the onion and garlic.
Add the broth, beans and seasoning and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the kale for the last 5.

name: Cream of Mushroom Soup (Lightened)
steps: Brown the mushrooms and onion in butter with garlic and thyme.
Add the broth and simmer 12 minutes.
Blend half, then stir in the milk.

name: Chicken and Dumpling-Style Soup with Cauliflower
steps: Simmer the chicken, vegetables and cauliflower in the broth 20 minutes.
Mix the almond flour and egg and drop small spoonfuls into the soup.
Cover and cook 8 minutes; finish with parsley.

name: Denver Omelet Muffins
steps: Divide the diced ham, pepper, onion and cheddar among six muffin cups.
Pour in the beaten eggs and bake at 350°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Breakfast Pizza on a Tortilla
steps: Crisp the tortillas, spread with marinara and top with sausage, spinach and mozzarella.
Crack an egg on each and bake at 400°F until set, about 8 minutes.

name: Brunch Egg Bake with Spinach and Tomato
steps: Layer the spinach, tomatoes, onion and feta in a dish.
Pour over the whisked eggs and milk and bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: Smoked Salmon Scramble with Chives
steps: Scramble the eggs gently in butter.
Fold in the cream cheese and salmon and finish with chives.

name: Breakfast Burrito Bowl with Sweet Potato
steps: Roast the sweet potato cubes.
Scramble the eggs in oil.
Build bowls with beans, eggs, avocado and salsa.

name: Bacon and Egg Fried Cauliflower Rice
steps: Crisp the bacon.
Cook the cauliflower rice in the fat, scramble in the eggs and spinach.
Season with soy sauce and finish with green onion.

name: Spinach Mushroom Frittata
steps: Sauté the onion, mushrooms and spinach in an ovenproof pan.
Pour in the eggs and parmesan, cook 4 minutes, then bake at 400°F for 10 minutes.

name: Ricotta Toast with Berries
steps: Toast the bread and spread with ricotta.
Top with berries, walnuts and cinnamon.

name: Turkey Sausage Breakfast Hash with Peppers
steps: Brown the sausage and set aside.
Cook the diced sweet potato, pepper and onion in oil until tender.
Return the sausage, make wells and cook the eggs in them.

name: Taco Salad Bowl with Chicken and Black Beans
steps: Season and sear the chicken; slice.
Arrange lettuce, beans, corn and tomato in bowls.
Top with chicken, avocado, salsa and a spoon of yogurt.

name: Cobb-Style Chopped Salad with Turkey
steps: Hard-boil and chop the eggs; crisp the bacon.
Arrange the lettuce with turkey, egg, bacon, avocado, tomato and blue cheese.
Dress with vinegar and oil.

name: Lentil Salad with Feta and Cucumber
steps: Combine the cooked lentils, cucumber, tomatoes, onion and parsley.
Dress with lemon and oil and top with feta.

name: Shaved Brussels Sprout Salad with Parmesan
steps: Shave the sprouts thin.
Toss with lemon, oil and mustard and top with parmesan and almonds.

name: Salmon Niçoise-Style Salad
steps: Roast the salmon at 400°F for 12 minutes; boil the potatoes and beans.
Arrange everything over greens with eggs, olives and tomatoes.
Dress with mustard, vinegar and oil.

name: Roasted Vegetable and Chickpea Grain Bowl
steps: Roast the vegetables and chickpeas with oil at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Serve over quinoa with tahini whisked with lemon.

name: Cucumber Edamame Salad with Sesame
steps: Boil the edamame 5 minutes and cool.
Toss with cucumber, vinegar, sesame oil, soy sauce, sesame seeds and green onion.

name: Pesto Zucchini Noodle Salad with Cherry Tomatoes
steps: Toss the zucchini noodles with pesto.
Add halved tomatoes, mozzarella and pine nuts.

name: Pumpkin Seed and Cranberry Spinach Salad with Chicken
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Toss the spinach with seeds, cranberries and goat cheese.
Dress with vinegar, oil and mustard and top with chicken.

name: Chocolate Hazelnut Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk the chia, almond milk, cocoa, sweetener and vanilla.
Chill 4 hours and top with chopped hazelnuts.

name: Greek Yogurt Panna Cotta
steps: Bloom the gelatin in warm milk.
Whisk into the yogurt with vanilla and sweetener.
Chill in cups for 3 hours and top with strawberries.

name: Cinnamon Almond Baked Apples
steps: Core the apples and fill with chopped almonds, cinnamon, butter and vanilla.
Bake at 375°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: Lemon Blueberry Yogurt Muffins
steps: Whisk the yogurt, eggs, lemon juice and sugar.
Fold in the oat flour, baking powder and blueberries.
Bake in a lined tin at 350°F for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Ice Cream
steps: Blend frozen banana with peanut butter, milk and cocoa until creamy.

name: Spiced Pear and Walnut Crumble
steps: Slice the pears into a dish with ginger and cinnamon.
Rub the oats, walnuts, butter and sugar into a crumble and spread on top.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

name: Deviled Egg Salad Bites on Cucumber
steps: Hard-boil and mash the eggs with yogurt and mustard.
Spoon onto cucumber rounds and dust with paprika and chives.

name: Baked Parmesan Zucchini Fries
steps: Cut the zucchini into sticks, dip in egg then the almond flour and parmesan mix.
Bake at 425°F for 20 to 22 minutes.
Serve with warm marinara.

name: Greek Yogurt Ranch Veggie Dip Cups
steps: Stir the ranch seasoning into the yogurt.
Spoon into cups and add the vegetable sticks.

name: Pesto Chicken Skewers
steps: Toss the chicken cubes with pesto and oil.
Thread onto skewers with tomatoes and zucchini.
Grill 10 to 12 minutes.

name: Salmon Salad Cucumber Bites
steps: Mix the salmon with yogurt, dill, lemon and capers.
Spoon onto thick cucumber rounds.
